findings.observed: Camera-off Prepare states that session calibration is cleared, yet the mint hand-joint overlay stays stretched over the empty-state icon and title through the terminal screenshot, while scalar owned-resource counts are zero.
findings.baselineOrRegression: UNESTABLISHED; current reviewed defect confirmed without attributing its introduction.

findings.rootCause: ReachLaboratory clears the visual ref and sets source OFF while retaining a mounted inactive ReachStage. ReachStage returns before drawing when inactive; the old effect cleanup only cancels animation. The previous canvas backing bitmap survives and stretches when the Prepare layout changes its display size.
findings.recommendedRepair: On canvas deactivation, cancel animation and clear the full backing bitmap with transform and pixel ratio handled, or remove the inactive stage. Shared camera and pointer canvas ownership should not retain inactive pixels.
findings.requiredRecapture: Repeat actual photographic setup, check and practice followed by stop on exact repaired source. Retain zero resource and no-further-work assertions. Inspect immediate and settled/resize camera-off screenshots with blank joint and pointer canvases. Preserve the original failing review and receipts.
